audit_baseline.note: The audit baseline predates explicit merged-cell rejection. The current scan classifies 30 body tables; two merged/ragged tables are now deliberately unsupported instead of being accepted.

table_classification.note: Accepted means the inference layer produced IR; it is not an independent visual-correctness score for Microsoft Word.

failure_classification.reason: The reference exposes a nested collection without an enclosing repeat; the compiler correctly refuses it instead of binding it at document root.
Every construct in the document is outside the supported generic-IR subset; the importer reports an empty safe subset rather than guessing.

limitations: AT-07 remains partial: binding evidence is deterministic schema/evidence matching, not independent human correctness labels.
Binding evidence rate counts only controls whose D365/DDSP path was actually checked; it is not a claim that every binding is semantically correct.
Table accuracy counts accepted inferred tables, not visually verified Word tables; merged/ragged/optional-cell cases are diagnosed and excluded.
Compilation uses a synthetic schema containing only imported paths and placeholder data; it proves structural compilation, not customer data correctness.
The corpus is private; only aggregate counts and rates are published.
